name: Contraptions
description: A contraption is a group of blocks moved as one: a drill carrying platform, a farm...

pages.title: Contraptions
pages.text:
[#](FFFFFF)[#]() **Key points**

- [#](FFFFFF)[#]() A **contraption** is a group of blocks moved as one.
- **Glue** and **chassis** decide which blocks come along.
- A **mover** decides how: piston, pulley, gantry, bearing or cart.
- Drills, saws and deployers on it work as it moves.

A **contraption** is a group of blocks moved as one: a drill carrying platform, a farm that drives itself, a train car. [#](7A3C9A)[Glue](entry://glossary/super_glue)[#]() and chassis decide what comes along; a mover decides how.

pages.title: Super Glue
pages.text: Bonds blocks into a shape. Blocks that hang on others need none. Click two corners to define an area.

pages.title: Linear Chassis
pages.text: Glues a row of blocks along its axis. The Radial Chassis grabs a disc around its axis. Both work with [#](2E5AAC)[wrench](entry://create_basics/tools_wrench)[#]() settings and chassis ranges.

**Movers**:

- Piston: pushes along a line

- Rope Pulley: up and down

- Gantry: slides on a shaft

- [#](7A3C9A)[Bearing](entry://glossary/bearing)[#](): spins

- Cart Assembler: rides a minecart

pages.title: Mechanical Bearing
pages.text: Rotates a structure, for [#](2E5AAC)[windmills](entry://create_basics/power_sources)[#](), rotating drills and turntables. The Clockwork Bearing makes clock hands.

pages.title: Builds that move
pages.text:
Any build can have a moving part: sails that turn, a door or drawbridge that swings on a bearing, a turntable, a wall a piston slides aside, a lift on a rope pulley, a gantry carrying a drill over a field.\
\
Most of a build stands still; make the part move that has a job moving.

pages.title: What comes along
pages.text:
- The block touching the mover's face.
- Blocks side by side inside one Super Glue area.
- Blocks that hang on others: torches, doors, ladders, carpets.
- Blocks on a chassis's sticky faces.
- Blocks a Schematicannon printed with Pre-glue on.
- A piston also pushes the whole line in front of it.

At most 2048 blocks.

pages.title: Speed and room
pages.text:
- Bearing: 6 degrees a second per RPM (a full turn in 1.9 s at 32 RPM).
- Piston, pulley, gantry: RPM / 25.6 blocks a second, 9.8 at most.
- Bearings, pistons and pulleys take 4 SU per RPM.

pages.title: Starting and steering
pages.text:
- Bearing: right-click it with an empty hand to start it; it turns while its shaft turns.
- Piston, pulley, gantry: start on their own and run until the end of their travel.
- A Gearshift with a lever, in the line that drives it, sends it back; a Clutch stops it.

[#](FFFFFF)[#]() **Watch out:** a turning part passes straight through blocks in its circle. A sliding part stops at the first solid block in its path; drills and saws break theirs as they go. A glue area takes every block in it that touches the part, so keep it off what stays put.

**Working parts**: Mechanical Drills, Saws, Harvesters and Ploughs do their job to whatever they pass. [#](2E5AAC)[Deployers](entry://create_basics/deployer)[#]() and [#](2E5AAC)[funnels](entry://create_basics/item_logistics)[#]() on the structure pull from and push into storage that moves with it.\
\
Storage on a contraption is a chest or vault attached to the structure.

pages.title: Mechanical Drill
pages.text: Breaks blocks in front of it, also while moving. Harvesters cut crops, Ploughs till soil.

**Bigger things**: Create Aeronautics builds flying ships out of the same idea, see [#](2E5AAC)[Airships](entry://flight/airships)[#](). Trains are contraptions too, see [#](2E5AAC)[Trains](entry://transport/trains)[#]().

[#](FFFFFF)[#]() **In depth.** A piston needs one extension pole behind it per block of reach, up to 64. Run back, a plain piston leaves its blocks out; a sticky one pulls them back. A rope pulley reaches 384 blocks down. A chassis grabs 8 blocks (a wrench sets 1 to 16). Stopping a bearing at a quarter turn takes a Sequenced Gearshift.
